allow_list.name: wallet_address
allow_list.justification: Wallet identity is the predeclared CopyTrade independence group, not a return-based selection feature.

allow_list.name: token_symbol
allow_list.justification: Token label is copied from the normalized GMGN round-trip record.

allow_list.name: hold_seconds
allow_list.justification: Round-trip holding duration is known at the copy event and is not derived from returns.

allow_list.name: wallet_return_percent
allow_list.justification: Original wallet return is retained as a benchmark beside the delayed-copy outcome.

allow_list.name: entry_trade_amount_usd
allow_list.justification: Timestamped matched entry size is a source-observed activity/liquidity proxy.

allow_list.name: exit_trade_amount_usd
allow_list.justification: Timestamped matched exit size is a source-observed activity/liquidity proxy.

allow_list.name: edge_kept_percent
allow_list.justification: Stored comparison of delayed-copy and wallet return for the same simulated round trip.

allow_list.name: entry_gap_seconds
allow_list.justification: Observed match gap after the configured copy delay.

allow_list.name: exit_gap_seconds
allow_list.justification: Observed match gap after the configured copy delay.

allow_list.name: gas_fee_usd
allow_list.justification: Stored simulated gas cost for the copied round trip.

allow_list.name: outcome_at
allow_list.justification: Round-trip exit time is the observed maturity boundary for the copy outcome.

allow_list.name: coverage_rate_percent
allow_list.justification: Explicit 100% outcome-coverage gate carried from the project adapter.

allow_list.name: coverage_status
allow_list.justification: Explicit copy-simulation coverage status carried from the project adapter.

allow_list.name: signal_type
allow_list.justification: Source-normalized signal type is stored at capture.

allow_list.name: observed_at
allow_list.justification: Verified source timestamp is the event-time anchor.

allow_list.name: trigger_at
allow_list.justification: Verified source trigger timestamp is the event-time anchor.

allow_list.name: token_address
allow_list.justification: Token identity is part of the captured source record.

allow_list.name: chain
allow_list.justification: Chain identity is part of the captured source record.

allow_list.name: market_cap
allow_list.justification: Allow only when source-provided at the trigger.

allow_list.name: trigger_mc
allow_list.justification: Allow only when source-provided at the trigger.

allow_list.name: first_trigger_mc
allow_list.justification: Allow only when source-provided at the first trigger.

allow_list.name: ingestion_latency_ms
allow_list.justification: Capture-time diagnostic, not a market condition.
